types.char: exactly one raw byte00..ff, no SQL display text. Semantic field enum approval belongs native effect predicate; unknown semantic enum => UNKNOWN, not an alternate codec.
types.name: u32 length + strict UTF8 bytes before first catalog NUL padding; reject embedded NUL and >63 bytes; no normalization
types.text: u32 length + strict UTF8 bytes; no NUL/normalization/locale/casts
types.timestamptz: i64 BE signed microseconds since2000-01-01T00:00:00Z; infinity/nonfinite reject
types.oidvector: u32 element count then each u32 BE OID; no NULL, exactly one vector dimension
types._oid: u32 dimensions (0 or1 only); dimensions0 is empty array and no cells; dimensions1 followed by i32 lower_bound and u32 element_count then cells in source order. Each cell begins u8 marker0=NULL(no payload),1=VALUE(exact u32 BE OID); any other marker rejects. Empty dimension1/count0 distinct from dimension0; signed lower_bound preserved. Dimensions>1 reject for current fields.
types._char: same dimensions/lower_bound/count envelope as _oid; each cell u8 marker0=NULL(no payload),1=VALUE(exactly one raw byte00..ff); other marker rejects
types._text: same dimensions/lower_bound/count envelope as _oid; each cell u8 marker0=NULL(no payload),1=VALUE(u32 byte length then strict UTF8); other marker rejects
types.aclitem[]: u32 count then sorted distinct entries:u32 grantee,u32 grantor,u16 privilege_count then sorted distinct (u16 canonical privilege enum,u8 grant_option00or01). Trusted adapter maps named privilege via frozen acl.c convert_aclright_to_string/aclexplode semantics, not server display formatting. Unknown native bits/names reject. Empty ACL count0 distinct from whole-field NULL. A NULL aclitem element rejects. No implicit ACL defaults in decoder.
types._aclitem: Identical to aclitem[]; PostgreSQL ACL array must be one-dimensional with lower bound1 and no NULL cells; any other dimensions/bounds reject. Empty accepts zero cells. Canonical frame omits redundant fixed shape after adapter validates it.
types.pg_node_tree: FORBIDDEN_RAW; source trusted adapter emits SHA256 exact source bytes with domain routine/policy identity; absence preserved; hash does not establish effects
types.SHA256: exact32 raw bytes, not hexadecimal display
types.bytes32: exact32 raw bytes, identical encoding to SHA256; domain identity remains per-field
types.CONFIG_ASSERTIONS_V2: u8 presence(0=NULL,1=array); if array u32 count then sorted distinct entries(u8 name enum1search_path2row_security3default_transaction_read_only4UNKNOWN_SETTING_PRESENT,u8 assertion0SAFE1UNSAFE2UNKNOWN,u8 scope1ROLE2DATABASE3ROLE_DATABASE4ROUTINE5SESSION). Each entry inherits outer row source relation and exact canonical primary key: pg_proc.oid or pg_db_role_setting(setdatabase,setrole). Missing outer key rejects. Scope must equal outer source: proconfig=ROUTINE; setconfig=ROLE_DATABASE if both OIDs nonzero, ROLE if database0, DATABASE if role0; both0 unsupported UNKNOWN. No raw config values/unknown names.

acl_name_mapping: Frozen convert_aclright_to_string names match enum keys byte-for-byte except sole exact alias ALTER SYSTEM->ALTER_SYSTEM; no case/space normalization; unknown strings reject.
field_frame: u16 relation tag || u16 field tag || u8 null marker(0NULL1VALUE) || u32 payload length || exact canonical payload. NULL requires nullable=true and length0. No alternative type IDs; type identity is bound by field table digest.
relation_frame: u16 relation tag || u32 row count || u32 byte length || sorted row frames. Row:u16 field count || field frames. All IDs unique, exact numeric order.
identity: SHA256 strict canonical JSON sorted keys UTF8 no whitespace of full fields/types/frame schema; expected digest from enrolled approved manifest, never sender choice
